description: Tracks every installed Vintage Story mod, plus the originals of forks we keep an eye on (installed:false). Structure defined in MOD_DB.schema.json. Dated action history (updates, decisions taken) belongs in AgentLogs/, not here.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; ships its own compat patches for Wildcraft Trees, Material Needs, More Animals
checked.note: Library/dependency, historically split off from Expanded Foods.

checked.known_incompatibilities: incompatible with "Simple Alchemy" (not installed) per the mod's own page. No other conflicts documented.
checked.note: Three-tier potion brewing (mortar & pestle -> brewing cauldron -> glass stirring spoon/herb-dried ingredients) for player buffs — combat, gathering, mobility, and utility effects (water breathing, recall/teleport, growth/shrink, creative-only flight). Potions can be drunk, thrown as splash, or used as weapon coatings. No freshness/perishability mechanic and not classified as food, so no interaction with FoodShelves (installed) at all. Has its own compatibility patch for A Culinary Artillery (installed): lets potions be drunk straight from ACA's glass bottles when 'drink from any container' is enabled in config. Extremely actively maintained (hundreds of config values; this version released the same day as this check). Targets 1.22.0-1.22.7, exact match for game 1.22.7.

Prewarms the vanilla anvil interaction-help cache (fixes a cache miss in BlockAnvil.GetPlacedBlockInteractionHelp()) to stop the freeze on first viewing an anvil. Patches a vanilla engine bug, not another mod — no patch_for target. Release page only tags game 1.22.0-1.22.2 and hasn't updated since May 2026, but modinfo.json only requires game >=1.22.0 with no upper cap; installed anyway on game 1.22.7 per user decision (paired with smithingplusbugfix on the same author's recommendation). One comment reported a 1.22.3 crash but it was traced to a server-connect timeout, not this mod. Revisit if the underlying vanilla bug ever gets fixed upstream by the game itself.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; ships its own compat patches for other mods' markers

RiverGen used alongside BetterRuins updates on an existing world risks terrain glitches/cliff chunk borders (upstream "Rivers Mod" has a fix, RiverGen does not) — only relevant if RiverGen is ever installed. Confirmed compatible with FieldsAndPlateaus, PlainsAndValleys (installed), Vanilla_PlusWorldGen, Worldgenfix(remix), Conquest Landform Overhaul, TerraPrety.
none found; has optional compat content for Bricklayers and Expanded Foods (installed)

checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork. It is the actively maintained lineage (1,033,321 downloads, current game-version support); copygirl's original appears superseded, not a competing live alternative.
checked.note: A parallel 2.0.0-pre.x pre-release branch also exists.
Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release only targets 1.16.0-1.16.5, dated 2022-03-01. Carry On (carryon) is the actively maintained fork; keep watching this in case the original resumes.

checked.known_incompatibilities: **partial incompatibility with Pet Map Markers (installed)** — per Pet Map Markers' own page, "you can run both mods together, but actually sharing your pet waypoints with others will do all sort of Weird Stuff." Fine to use if you don't share pet waypoints via Cartographer.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none stated on page; no deprecation notice
checked.fork_decision: Keep both — see CommonLib-Forked entry above; confirmed that whatever mods require the original can't substitute the fork and vice versa.
checked.note: Stalled at game 1.21 support (last release only targets 1.21.0/1.21.1, dated 2025-09-13) while commonlibforked has moved to 1.22.

checked.fork_decision: Keep, though also currently unused. Same dependency scan found nothing installed requires this either — but kept as the safer of the two to retain against a future mod needing a CommonLib-family dependency, since commonlibforked's own page warns it doesn't work with some of the original author's other mods (narrower compatibility). commonlibforked was removed (see forked_by) since it had zero installed dependents and the narrower compatibility.

Removed. User confirmed no installed mod uses CommonLib at all (matches the dependency scan finding from when commonlibforked was removed for the same reason) — both CommonLib variants are now uninstalled, kept only as tracked (installed: false) entries in case a future mod needs one specifically.

checked.known_incompatibilities: description says this fork pairs specifically with the author's own fork of Player Corpse (we have `playercorpseforkedazu` installed, a *different* fork — relationship unconfirmed) and states it "will not work with [DArkHekRoMaNT's] other mods."
checked.fork_decision: Keep both — decision: mods that depend on the original CommonLib need the original, mods that depend on the fork need the fork; they're not interchangeable, so both stay installed as separate dependencies.
checked.note: Both this and the original CommonLib are currently installed — see fork_decision. Targets game 1.22.0.

checked.fork_decision: Removed. Scanned all 44 installed mods' modinfo.json dependencies directly and found none declare a dependency on commonlib or commonlibforked. The one mod this fork's own page says it's specifically paired with (playercorpseforkedazu) dropped its CommonLib dependency as of v1.14.0, a version older than the one installed here. Not used by anything currently installed; removed via sync-mods.ps1 by setting installed: false here.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; historical YamlDotNet.dll conflict with BillyGalbreath's mods was already resolved upstream long ago
checked.note: Now requires vsimgui >=1.2.0 (updated vsimgui to 1.2.7 in the same pass to satisfy this). Updated 2026-09-01, current.

Required by Config lib (installed, now needs >=1.2.0 — satisfied). Updated 2026-09-01, current — includes an ARM64 Mac fix and a crash fix for missing language glyph ranges.

checked.known_incompatibilities: **its own page warns it may conflict with any mod that modifies the prospecting pickaxe in any way** — see the ProspectTogether entry above for the cross-check (likely fine, not fully confirmed).
checked.fork_decision: Keep — this is effectively the actively maintained continuation published under the original mod ID with the original author's blessing, not a competing parallel fork.
checked.note: BetterProspecting by JohnVintageStory — page states it's "identical to DurableBetterProspecting, but preserving the original mod ID betterprospecting" (JohnVintageStory is credited as contributor/original creator and allowed reuse of the mod page/ID).

checked.known_incompatibilities: incompatible with the unofficial "Art of Cooking" (not installed); needs a separate compat patch to run alongside Wildcraft: Fruits & Nuts (not installed). Companion to FoodShelves (installed) and Butchering (installed).

checked.known_incompatibilities: incompatible with the unofficial "Art of Cooking" (not installed); needs a separate compat patch to run alongside Wildcraft: Fruits & Nuts (not installed) — same watch-items as Core.
checked.note: Hard dependency on Expanded Foods: Core (installed): "DO NOT USE THIS MOD WITHOUT EXPANDED FOODS: CORE INSTALLED!!!" Adds 7 meal recipes scooped from cooking pots/mixing bowls (not craftable directly). Optional companion to Chef's Tricks (also installed) for extra ingredients (salt, lime, resin). Meals were fully removed from Core as of Core dev.9 (2026-06-02) and live only in this module now — this mod is what restores that functionality. Known bug: perish-timer issue on meals containing bone broth causes premature spoilage. Targets 1.22.3–1.22.7.

Hard dependency on Expanded Foods: Core (installed): "DO NOT USE THIS MOD WITHOUT EXPANDED FOODS: CORE INSTALLED!!!" Also relies on A Culinary Artillery (installed) for processing methods. Adds salt processing from saltwater, resin tapping, breadcrumb animal feed, eggshell-to-lime, and expanded oil uses — split out of Core as of Core dev.10 (2026-06-14). Confirmed compatible with More Animals (not installed). No known incompatibilities documented. Targets 1.22.3–1.22.7.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; recommends pairing with Config lib (installed) for configuration options
checked.note: Client-side, safe to add/remove from existing worlds. Targets 1.22.0–1.22.2.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; as of v1.8.1 no longer hard-requires Config lib/Dear ImGui (both installed) — works standalone, but the in-game settings panel needs them when present.
checked.note: Client-side. Targets 1.22.5.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none confirmed; own docs note the chunk-heightmap technique "has potential to cause issues with some mods (none confirmed so far)." Pairs well with Algernon's Terrain Sampler Lib (not installed) for performance.

none found; explicitly compatible with Expanded Foods (installed), CarryOn (installed), Chisel Tools (installed), Butchering (installed), Wildcraft: Fruits and Nuts, and Long-Term Food. v3.0.0 was a breaking change requiring a mod-content wipe on existing worlds — already past that point at the installed 3.0.5.
checked.note: Confirmed companion mod for Expanded Foods (installed), matching AGENTS.md's expected relationship.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; confirmed compatible with Status HUD Continued and Extended HUD Info (neither installed).
checked.fork_decision: Keep — it's the actively maintained continuation; the original is defunct.
checked.note: Client-side only. Targets 1.22.0–1.22.3. Originated as a community patch of "Simple HUD Clock" by Rhonen after that mod stopped receiving updates; author later did a full rewrite for VS 1.22 (v4.0) and now maintains it as its own project under modid `hudclockpatch`.

checked.note: Author only releases for stable game builds, not pre-releases/RCs. Targets 1.22.0.

none found; complements Toolsmith durability/sharpness bars (not confirmed installed); fully configurable per-bar
none found; own docs state "most mods should peacefully coexist with it." Required by Wolf taming (installed) and Pet Map Markers (installed).

checked.note: Required by Terrain Slabs (installed, min version 1.1.3 — satisfied).

checked.known_incompatibilities: potential conflict with any other landform-patching worldgen mod; author recommends running only one such mod per world. Confirmed compatible with BetterRuins (installed) worldgen.

checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork — it has confirmed active 1.22.x releases through August 2026; the original's status is unconfirmed from available data.

checked.note: Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release only targets 1.21.0-1.21.1, dated 2025-09-13. Same author as CommonLib (commonlib) and Stone Quarry (stonequarry), both also stalled on 1.21.x. Player Corpse fork (playercorpseforkedazu) is the actively maintained fork, created specifically for 1.22+ support.

Same author as FoodShelves (installed); author's own page cross-promotes FoodShelves as a companion mod. No overlap: this mod has no freshness/preservation mechanics and covers non-food display/storage instead — wardrobes, weapon/accessory racks and stands, resource bins, decorative displays. No known conflicts with FoodShelves or anything else installed. Note for future updates: 2.0.0+ required wiping old mod content on existing worlds — irrelevant for this fresh install. Targets 1.22.0–1.22.7.

Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release only targets 1.18.2-1.18.3, dated 2023-05-13. ProspectTogether (prospecttogether) is the actively maintained fork; P3t3rix is credited there as a contributor.

checked.known_incompatibilities: Watch-item: also installed alongside Durable Better Prospecting, which warns about mods that modify the prospecting pickaxe — see open_flags.
checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork; it supersedes ProspectorInfo with added player-to-player data sharing, and the original author (P3t3rix) is credited as a contributor here rather than maintaining a competing 1.22 release.

checked.note: Client-side only cosmetic texture tweak that makes ore veins more visible inside rock blocks (sulfur/quartz untouched); no server component needed. Officially targets only 1.15.0-1.20.3 (last release 2021-11-12, unmaintained), but community comments confirm it still works fine on 1.21.x/1.22.x. No known conflicts reported; independent of Durable Better Prospecting / ProspectTogether since those affect the prospecting pickaxe/signal mechanic, not ore textures. User previously ran this mod and confirmed it worked well.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; ships compat patches for Primitive Survival's Smoker, More Torch Holders, Stone Bake Oven (installed), and Medieval Expansion. Requires running `/realsmoke disable` before removing it from an existing world.

None found. Integrates with Config lib (installed, customizes boat speed/handling) and Carry On (installed, lets items attach to vessels). Optional integrations with PhysicsLib (not installed, enables standing on boats), Heraldry Banners and Draconis (neither installed, cosmetic-only: banners as drakkar flags, dragonhorns on prows). Minor known issues: some multiplayer dismount desync, a non-critical sail-emblem warning message.
checked.note: Adds 8 vessels: smaller than vanilla's Raft (Kayak, Coracle, Caballito de totora — inventory-slot-sized), mid-range (Punter, Reed longboat, Papyrus sailer, Catboat), and larger than vanilla's Sailboat (Drakkar, seats ~12). Release page tags only cover 1.22.0-1.22.3, but modinfo.json only requires game >=1.22.0 with no upper cap — installed on 1.22.7 following the same pattern as smithingplusbugfix/anvilperformanceoptimization.

checked.known_incompatibilities: redundant with "Thrifty Smithing" (incompatible after v1.6.7, not installed) and with Anvil Metal Recovery (tool/bits-recovery overlap, not installed — also flagged as a lag source on Knapster's page). Recommends disabling XSkills bits-recovery for balance if XSkills is installed (not installed here). Compatible with Toolsmith and Salty's Manual Tool Crafting (neither confirmed installed).

checked.note: This RC has a known bug causing lag spikes/crashes when looking at an anvil, plus a chisel-drag delay and iron bloom stutter. Installed smithingplusbugfix as a hotfix patch for these (see that entry's patch_for). Revisit once SmithingPlus ships a stable release that absorbs the fix — the patch should then be removable per AGENTS.md line 4.

xSkills Fork (xskillsfork) is now installed — the previously-hypothetical recommendation above is now a real to-do: disable xSkills' own metal-bits smithing feature in its config so it doesn't duplicate SmithingPlus' bit-smithing. Not done automatically since it's an in-game config change, not a MOD_DB/file change — flagging here so it isn't forgotten.

checked.known_incompatibilities: Requires smithingplus 1.9.0-rc.1 exactly (dependency pin in modinfo.json) — installed SmithingPlus matches. Release page tags only cover game 1.22.1-1.22.3 (self-flagged "potentially outdated"), but modinfo.json only requires game >=1.22.0 with no upper cap; installed anyway on game 1.22.7 per user decision (author explicitly recommends pairing with Anvil Performance Optimization, also installed) since no compatibility problems have been reported either way.
checked.note: Fixes: anvil lag spike/crash on first view, chisel-drag-hold delay, iron bloom heating stutter. Recommended by its own author to be paired with Anvil Performance Optimization for the anvil fix specifically. Remove once SmithingPlus itself ships a stable release absorbing these fixes.

Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release targets 1.16.0-1.17.0 (users report it also works on 1.17.2+), dated 2022-05-03. A separate specializedbags-10Slot variant also exists upstream. SpecializedBags Revived (specialexpandedbags) is the actively maintained fork.

checked.known_incompatibilities: conflicts with "Wildcraft: Trees and Shrubs" (not installed) — both mods modify the same game files; author says a fix is in progress. Confirmed compatible with BetterRuins (installed).
checked.fork_decision: Keep the revived version — actively maintained through 2026; could not confirm from either page whether the original has since been reclaimed or updated by its original author.
checked.note: Targets 1.22.2.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; integrates with Real Smoke (installed) for visual effects; partial XSkills support (Baking Space only, XSkills not installed)

checked.note: Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release only targets 1.21.0-1.21.1, dated 2025-09-13. Stone Quarry Standalone Repack (stonequarryrepckfipil) is the actively maintained fork, chosen specifically because it dropped the CommonLib dependency.

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found — not affected by the CommonLib vs CommonLib-Forked conflict, since it has no CommonLib dependency at all.
checked.fork_decision: Keep the repack — original author "currently doesn't have the time or motivation to update his mods for VS 1.22"; repack was chosen specifically to avoid the CommonLib version conflict already flagged in this file, and preserves save compatibility.

checked.known_incompatibilities: Item Rarity mods (not installed) — grid-crafted tools won't display rarity properly. Combat Overhaul/weapon packs (not installed) unaffected, no mechanical benefit either way.
checked.note: Reworks tools into separate head/handle/binding components with independent durability (heads get 5x vanilla durability); adds a sharpness stat maintained via Grindstones/portable Whetstones, and a Workbench for reforging/repairing worn parts instead of discarding whole tools. Recommended companion to SmithingPlus (installed) — Toolsmith disables its own internal "Smithing with Bits" when SmithingPlus is loaded so the two don't duplicate that system. Confirmed compatible with QP's Chisel Tools (installed): most of its tools are repairable "Smithed Tools", others are registered "blunt" and take minimal wear. Stone Quarry's (installed) chisels and rubble hammer are integrated directly. A meaningful gameplay/mechanics change, not just a QoL layer — user made the call after being told this explicitly. Release tags stop at 1.22.6 (same pattern as several other installed mods that lag one game-patch behind on tagging); no reported issues on 1.22.7.

mods.name: Temporals Reformed - An Enemy Behavior Overhaul
mods.author: Darthzz

checked.known_incompatibilities: Potential conflict with xSkills Fork around temporal mob AI during storms remains unresolved as of xSkills Fork 1.0.99 — searched its full changelog, no mention of Temporals Reformed or its author (Darthzz) at all; xSkills' own "Temporal Adaptation" skill tree is an unrelated internal feature (player-side temporal-stability perks, not enemy AI).
checked.fork_decision: Removed (user call) as a preventative measure ahead of installing xSkills Fork — a much larger, more heavily-integrated mod (174k downloads with explicit compat patches for most of this list) — rather than keep an unverified conflict live between it and a comparatively young, self-described "very experimental" mod (13.9k downloads, only installed 2026-09-01). Only touches vanilla entity JSON (health/damage/spawn/behavior), no worldgen or persistent save data, so this and any future reinstall should be safe either direction. Kept tracked here (installed: false) in case the xSkills conflict question ever gets a real answer and it's worth revisiting.
checked.note: Self-described as "very experimental and prone to drastic changes." Not recommended alongside Combat Overhaul either (not installed) — main version changes mob health/damage in ways clash with CO's rebalance; a 'Temporals Lite' variant (temporalslite, not installed) exists for that pairing if ever revisited.

checked.known_incompatibilities: connected textures don't work with Conquest VS Edition slabs (not confirmed installed); bamboo/redwood saplings don't replace slabs when growing; Footprints and Trail Mod need separate patches (neither installed). **Hard dependency on Place on slabs >=1.1.3 (installed version 1.2.0 satisfies this).**
checked.note: Confirmed compatible with BetterRuins (installed).

checked.known_incompatibilities: conflicts with Translocator Relocator [BETA] (not installed) — both installed together blocks translocator deconstruction. A past fix (1.6.2) addressed a compatibility issue with Immersive Mining (not installed).
checked.note: Adds what vanilla doesn't have: vanilla translocators (found pre-linked in ruins) can't be built, moved, or relinked. This mod adds a Pry Bar (smithed on an anvil from 1 steel ingot) to deconstruct existing translocators for parts, a craftable replacement translocator (3 steel, 2 gold, 1 rough diamond), and a Linker tool to connect any two translocators up to 8000 blocks apart, always bidirectional. Optional dependencies on Config lib and Dear ImGui (both installed) for an in-game config GUI. Not on Toolsmith's (installed) explicit compatibility list — the Pry Bar likely just behaves as a plain single-durability "Smithed Tool" there rather than getting Toolsmith's head/handle/binding breakdown; no reported issues either way. Targets 1.22.0-pre.1 through 1.22.7 (matches game version exactly, unusually current for this list).

checked.known_incompatibilities: none found; requires Pet AI (installed). Ships patches for other creature mods (bowtorns, shivers — not confirmed installed).
checked.note: Confirmed full support from Pet Map Markers (installed).

checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork — the duplication-bug fix is the entire reason it exists, and there's no evidence the original has caught up.

checked.note: Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release only targets up to 1.21.0, dated 2025-09-09. xLib Fork (xlibfork) is the actively maintained continuation, required by xSkills Fork (installed).

checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork — the original stalled on 1.21.0 over a year ago; this fork targets 1.22.0-pre.1 through 1.22.7 and is xSkills Fork's actual required dependency.
checked.note: Pure backend library (skill/ability/effect framework, client-server sync, save/load) — no visible content on its own. Installed solely because xSkills Fork requires it.
Not maintained for game 1.22.x — last release 0.9.0-pre.2 dated 2025-09-09. xSkills Fork (xskillsfork) is the actively maintained continuation, same author (El_Neuman) as xLib Fork.

checked.known_incompatibilities: Item Rarity + Toolsmith together is flagged as a conflict by xSkills' own changelog (neither installed, not relevant here). Electrical Progressive cooking-XP ambiguous-match warning with multiplayer ACA saucepan use (Electrical Progressive not installed). No mention anywhere of Temporals Reformed (removed, see that entry) — the earlier flagged watch-item with it was never addressed by either mod and stays unresolved/moot now that it's uninstalled.
checked.fork_decision: Keep the fork — same reasoning as xLib Fork: original (xskills) stalled on 1.21.0, this is the actively maintained 1.22.x continuation by the same author as xLib Fork.
checked.note: RPG progression system: 12 skill trees (Survival, Combat, Mining, Digging, Forestry, Farming, Fishing, Husbandry, Metalworking, Pottery, Cooking, Temporal Adaptation) plus Tailoring, Sailing, Riding, and a WIP Alchemy tree. Requires xLib Fork (installed) and Dear ImGui (vsimgui, installed). Has explicit, confirmed compatibility patches for a large chunk of this modlist: SmithingPlus (can disable xSkills' own bit-smithing to avoid duplicating SmithingPlus' — see that entry's updated note), Toolsmith (Metalbits Forging perk conflict fixed), A Culinary Artillery + Expanded Foods (cauldron/pot/liquid-recipe support), Butchering (dedicated Hunter Bag perk slot), Better Prospecting/ProspectTogether (panning yield bonuses), Knapster, Stone Bake Oven (full compat), and Alchemy (WIP compat). Cooking perks touch NutritionProps/NutritionPropsPerLitre/nutritionPropsWhenInMeal directly — worth watching if any other food mod ever overrides those same attributes, though nothing currently installed is flagged as doing so. Targets 1.22.0-pre.1 through 1.22.7 exactly.

open_flags: Cartographer vs. Pet Map Markers, both installed. Not a hard conflict — both mods explicitly say they can run together — but sharing pet waypoints *through* Cartographer is called out by Pet Map Markers' own page as causing "Weird Stuff." No action taken; just avoid using Cartographer's sharing feature for pet waypoints if that matters to you.

Durable Better Prospecting vs. ProspectTogether, both installed. Durable Better Prospecting warns generically against any mod that alters the prospecting pickaxe; ProspectTogether's own description doesn't claim to touch the pickaxe (it shares/stores prospecting data instead), so they're likely compatible, but neither page explicitly confirms the pairing. Flagging so you're aware, no changes made.
